about: the embeddings endpoint answers 500 with a plain-text body, so a knowledge_base call fails inside the agent

json.chatInput: Summarise section 4 of the uploaded PDF in three bullet points.

responses.body: upstream connect error or disconnect/reset before headers. reset reason: overflow

connector.none: no Claude connector for OpenAI embeddings; the Claude side serves the same response through its HTTP mock

reads.note: Embeddings OpenAI v1.2 (model left at text-embedding-3-small) embeds the agent's knowledge_base query: POST /v1/embeddings; the openai SDK asks for encoding_format base64, so the vector is base64 of 1536 little-endian float32. The shim does not answer embeddings, so the vector is fixed here. Called only when the agent decides to use the knowledge_base tool. A 500 with a text body; the openai SDK retries (maxRetries 2 by default) before the tool reports the error to the agent

branches: no IF/Switch: a tool call errors; the agent answers without the knowledge base or the run fails, as n8n decides
expect.offline: The knowledge base is the in-memory vector store (key vector_store_key), filled only by the separate form upload path (Upload your file here → Insert Data to Store). A chat run starts with that store empty in a fresh n8n, so knowledge_base returns no documents (assumed: no other run in the same n8n process inserted under that key). Whether the agent calls the tool is model-driven; the only effect is the chat reply. Query Data Tool and Insert Data to Store are left unlisted (validate warns): they read and write n8n's process memory, which no fixture source can seed or observe
